metadata.question: Did burn scars near San Jose, California on August 26, 2020 expand in comparison to the same region in June?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: MODIS Burned Area Monthly (MCD64A1) – it gives a burn‐date layer that we can binarize to “burned / not-burned” for the two months. - Region: a ~20-km box around San José, CA (37.33 N, 121.89 W). - Dates: – June 2020 composite → 2020-06-01 … 2020-06-30 – August 2020 composite → 2020-08-01 … 2020-08-31 (so the 26 Aug event is included). 2. Masking strategy - MCD64A1 is already QA-screened; just keep the “burn date” band. - A pixel is “burned” if the burn-date is non-zero within the month window. 3. Logic - Count burned pixels in June. - Count burned pixels in August. - If either count is 0 (no valid pixels) → C2. - If the new burned-pixel count is strictly larger → A (Yes); else B (No). - If any reducer returns None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Region & dates san_jose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.89, 37.33]).buffer(20000) # 20 km june = ee.DateRange('2020-06-01', '2020-06-30') aug = ee.DateRange('2020-08-01', '2020-08-31') # 2. Burned-area collection def monthlyBurn(dr): return (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1') .filterDate(dr.start(), dr.end()) .select('BurnDate') .mosaic() .gt(0)) # 1 = burned, 0 = unburned burn_june = monthlyBurn(june) burn_aug = monthlyBurn(aug) # 3. Burn-pixel counts count_j = (burn_june.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=san_jose, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('BurnDate').getInfo()) count_a = (burn_aug.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()) .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=san_jose, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('BurnDate').getInfo()) # 4. Validation if count_j is None or count_a is None: print("C3") else: print(f"June burnt area (km²): {count_j/1e6:.2f}") print(f"Aug burnt area (km²): {count_a/1e6:.2f}") if count_a > count_j: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Region & dates
san_jose = ee.Geometry.Point([-121.89, 37.33]).buffer(20000)  # 20 km
june = ee.DateRange('2020-06-01', '2020-06-30')
aug  = ee.DateRange('2020-08-01', '2020-08-31')

# 2. Burned-area collection
def monthlyBurn(dr):
    return (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD64A1')
              .filterDate(dr.start(), dr.end())
              .select('BurnDate')
              .mosaic()
              .gt(0))  # 1 = burned, 0 = unburned

burn_june = monthlyBurn(june)
burn_aug  = monthlyBurn(aug)

# 3. Burn-pixel counts
count_j = (burn_june.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
                     .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                   geometry=san_jose,
                                   scale=1000,
                                   maxPixels=1e9)
                     .get('BurnDate').getInfo())
count_a = (burn_aug.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
                    .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                  geometry=san_jose,
                                  scale=1000,
                                  maxPixels=1e9)
                    .get('BurnDate').getInfo())

# 4. Validation
if count_j is None or count_a is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"June burnt area (km²): {count_j/1e6:.2f}")
    print(f"Aug burnt area (km²):  {count_a/1e6:.2f}")
    if count_a > count_j:
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>B</answer>")
